entrance.text: Your party of four stands before the crumbling entrance to an old dungeon. Torchlight flickers somewhere deep inside.

corridor_fork.text: Just inside, the corridor splits: one way flickers with torchlight, the other is shrouded in quiet darkness. Exploration is part of the adventure — different paths lead to different risks.

quiet_passage.text: You creep through the dark passage undetected. No traps here — but you can't be sure what's waiting ahead either.

corridor_trap.text: The corridor floor is covered in strange tiles. One looks slightly loose — it might be a pressure-plate trap. This is your first lesson: not every hazard needs to be fought.

trap_avoided.text: You spot the trigger and step over it safely. The party presses on unharmed.

trap_triggered.text: The tile clicks. A dart shoots from the wall and catches one of your heroes! A small price for the lesson: always check for traps.

goblin_room.text: Two goblins turn and snarl at you. They are Level 3 minions. Combat, bribery, and fleeing are all valid tactics — Four Against Darkness rewards good judgement over brute force.

goblin_fight_resolution.text: You roll to attack and the goblins fall before your blades! The path ahead is clear.

goblin_fight_setback.text: Your attack goes wide and a goblin's blade catches one of your heroes before you finish them off. Combat always carries risk — that's why bribery and fleeing are on the table too.

goblin_bribe_success.text: The goblins snatch the gold and scurry off, leaving the path clear without a single blow struck.

goblin_flee.text: You beat a hasty retreat back down the corridor, goblins hooting behind you. Fleeing is always an option when the odds look bad — regrouping and trying another approach beats a bad fight.

treasure_room.text: Beyond the goblins lies a small chest and a shimmering rune etched into the far wall.

magic_lesson.text: Your Wizard channels arcane energy to decipher the rune, revealing a hidden catch on the chest. Magic can solve problems combat cannot.

treasure_found.text: Inside the chest: a stash of gold, split evenly among your party, and a masterwork dagger tucked beneath it. Tutorial complete — you've learned the basics: combat, traps, fleeing, and magic.

party_wiped.text: Your entire party has fallen. Four Against Darkness is unforgiving that way — but every defeat is a lesson for the next attempt.
